claim_title: Habitual coffee intake shapes the gut microbiome and modifies cognition
caption: **Coffee, gut bacteria, and the brain.** The single reviewed study found regular coffee drinkers have a distinct gut microbiome and differences in impulsivity and emotional reactivity, with some changes shifting when coffee stopped. But it can't prove coffee is the cause — the groups differed in genetics and diversity, sample groups were as small as 15-16 people, and the study was funded by a coffee industry body. Read the positive findings with caution.
subtitle: One small study links coffee to microbiome and cognition, but can't prove cause.
